description: This file defines a Checkout servlet that handles HTTP GET requests to facilitate the checkout process in an online grocery ordering system, retrieving cart items from the session and forwarding to the order placement JSP page.

classes.name: Checkout
classes.description: A servlet class that manages the checkout process by retrieving cart items from session and forwarding to the checkout JSP page.

methods.name: doGet
methods.description: Handles HTTP GET requests; retrieves cart items from session, checks for their existence, and forwards to the appropriate JSP page with relevant data.
